verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk operation, such as acting on many instances, filesystems or keys in a single call or console action. What it does show is either a per-resource API (launch or restart instances programmatically) that a developer could script into a loop, or adjacent features: workspace-wide firewall rules, multi-GPU clusters as a single product, and Slurm job scheduling. These are building blocks or adjacent controls, so they earn no credit for this story.
